reasoning: The Tools page implements a partial filtering system with significant gaps. Only 2 of 4 required filters are functional: category filter (fully working) and search field (integrated with global store). The status filter uses incorrect values (active/expiring/unused instead of Active/Inactive/Pending/All), department filter is completely commented out, and cost range filter is entirely missing. The reset filters button works correctly for available filters. However, there is no visual feedback system (badges, highlights, counts) to indicate active filters. Filter combinations can work for the 2 active filters (status + category + search) but cannot be fully tested due to missing filters. The implementation shows good architectural patterns (React Query, Zustand store, proper state management) but fails to meet the complete filtering requirements specified in the rule.
